## 1. Sentinel Değer Dönüşümü ve Eksik Veri Özeti

```{r sentinel-and-summary}
df_toy <- data.frame(
  V1 = c(1, 3, 6, NA, 7, 1, NA, 9, 15),
  V2 = c(7, NA, 5, 9, 12, NA, NA, 2, 3),
  V3 = c(NA, 12, 5, 6, 3, 7, 2, NA, 99)
)

df_clean <- replace_sentinel_with_na(df_toy, sentinels = 99)
summarize_missingness(df_clean)
```

## 2. Basit Değer Atama (Ortalama, Medyan, İstatistiksel Mod, Sabit)

Eski koddaki `base::mode` hatası `stat_mode()` ile giderilmiştir:

```{r simple-imputation}
df_imputed <- df_clean
df_imputed$V1 <- impute_vector(df_imputed$V1, strategy = "mean")
df_imputed$V2 <- impute_vector(df_imputed$V2, strategy = "median")
df_imputed$V3 <- impute_vector(df_imputed$V3, strategy = "mode")
df_imputed
```

## 3. Hitters Veri Setinde Deterministik Eksik Veri Simülasyonu ve Değerlendirme

```{r hitters-imputation}
if (requireNamespace("ISLR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data("Hitters", package = "ISLR", envir = environment())
  sim <- inject_random_missingness(
    Hitters,
    counts_per_col = c(Hits = 7, Runs = 9, RBI = 5),
    seed = 42L
  )
  print(summarize_missingness(sim$data)[1:5, ])

  # Ortalama ile doldurma doğruluğu
  mean_filled <- sim$data
  for (col in c("Hits", "Runs", "RBI")) {
    mean_filled[[col]] <- impute_vector(mean_filled[[col]], strategy = "mean")
  }
  print(evaluate_imputation_mae(Hitters, mean_filled, sim$masked_indices))
}
```
